_comment: Ideology framing layered on top of the personality voice (NPCConversation II.9 CREED VOICE). An NPC's creed is folded into one family by its axes (CreedVoice.ideologyFamily); a few creeds have a special bank that wins over their family. flavour is a stray aside; the other pools frame one topic. Every line is a short sentence appended after what was already said.

flavour: {DA WORKERS BUILT DIS TOWN|WORKERS BUILT ALL OF DIS}, REMEMBER DAT!
{SOLIDARITY|SOLIDARITY, COMRADE}. IT IZ DA ONLY TINK DAT WORKS!
DA BOSSES {NEVER|NO} LOSE SLEEP OVER ANY OF IT!
politics: PARLIAMENT IZ A CLUB FOR DA OWNERS!
{NATIONALISE IT|PUT IT IN COMMON HANDS}, ALL OF IT!
work: {JOIN DA UNION|GET A UNION CARD}, DAT IZ ME ADVICE!
DEY PAY US IN CRUMBS AN' CALL IT A WAGE!
war: RICH MEN'S WAR, POOR MEN'S BLOOD!
DA WORKERS OF {enemy} IZ NO ME BAD 'UN!
family: A FAMILY NEEDS A WAGE AN' A FREE CLINIC. SERMONS CAN WAIT!
EVERY CHILD DESERVES A SCHOOL AN' A HOT MEAL!
goblins: EVEN DA GOBLINS IZ RULED BY A CHIEF AN' HIS CRONIES!
DA HORDE IZ WHAT HAPPENS WHEN MIGHT OWNS EVERYTINK!
money: MONEY IZ THEFT WIT BETTER TAILORIN'!
{RENTS|PRICES} UP, WAGES FLAT. FUNNY, DAT!
elections: VOTE LEFT, DEN KEEP ORGANISIN'!
WHOEVER WINS, DA STRIKE FUND STAYS FULL!

flavour: A FAIR DEAL FOR EVERYONE, DAT IZ ALL ME ASK!
{REFORM|STEADY REFORM}, ONE STEP AT A TIME!
GOOD SCHOOLS AN' A DECENT PENSION. IZ DAT TOO MUCH?
politics: WE NEED A GOVERNMENT DAT {LISTENS|ACTUALLY LISTENS}!
COMPROMISE NO IZ A DIRTY WORD!
work: FAIR PAY FOR A FAIR DAY.
A MINIMUM WAGE NEVER RUINED ANYBODY!
war: DIPLOMACY FIRST, ALWAYS.
SEND DA ONU AN' KEEP DA TANKS IN DA BARRACKS!
family: {CHILDCARE|PARENTAL LEAVE} SHOULD BE A RIGHT!
A FAMILY NO SHOULD CHOOSE BETWEEN RENT AN' BREAD!
goblins: WE SHOULD TAKE IN DA REFUGEES FROM DA HORDE!
ALLIANCES STOP A HORDE BETTER DEN ANY WALL!
money: TAX DA RICH A LIL', HELP DA REST A LOT!
PUBLIC SERVICES IZ MONEY WELL SPENT!
elections: EVERY VOTE COUNTS. ESPECIALLY ME!
TURNOUT WINS ELECTIONS. SLOGANS COUNT FOR LIL'!

flavour: {LETZ LOOK AT DA NUMBERS|DA NUMBERS NEVER LIE}!
MODERATION IN ALL TINKZ.
BOTH SIDES HAB A POINT, AS USUAL!
politics: COMPETENT PEOPLE IN CHARGE, DAT IZ ALL ME WANT!
LESS SHOUTIN', MORE PLANNIN'!
work: EFFICIENCY PAYS EVERYONE IN DA END!
SKILLS. TRAININ'. DAT IZ DA ANSWER!
war: WAR IZ BAD FOR TRADE AN' WORSE FOR PEOPLE!
SANCTIONS FIRST, DEN TALKS!
family: FAMILIES NEED STABILITY MORE DEN SPEECHES!
GOOD PLANNIN' STARTS AT DA KITCHEN TABLE!
goblins: A STABLE BORDER IZ A SENSIBLE BORDER!
DA HORDE IZ A PROBLEM TA MANAGE WIT A COOL HEAD!
money: A BALANCED BUDGET HELPS EVERYONE!
MARKETS WORK, MOSTLY, WIT A REFEREE!
elections: ME WILL VOTE FOR WHOEVER HAB A PLAN!
READ DA MANIFESTOS. NOBODY DOES!

flavour: {HARD WORK|HARD WORK AN' COMMON SENSE} BUILT DIS COUNTRY!
TINKZ WAZ BETTER WHEN PEOPLE KNEW DEY PLACE!
{TRADITION|TRADITION MATTERS}. SOMEBODY HAB TA SAY IT!
politics: LESS GOVERNMENT, LOWER TAXES!
DA STATE SHOULD KEEP ITS NOSE OUT OF ME BUSINESS!
work: NOBODY EVER GOT RICH WAITIN' FOR HANDOUTS!
AN HONEST DAY'S WORK, DAT IZ DA SECRET!
war: STRENGTH KEEPS DA PEACE.
A STRONG ARMY MEANS NOBODY TRIES IT!
family: DA FAMILY IZ DA BEDROCK OF EVERYTINK!
CHILDREN NEED DISCIPLINE AN' CHURCH ON SUNDAY!
goblins: SECURE DA BORDER FIRST, ASK QUESTIONS LATER!
DA HORDE RESPECTS ONE TINK: STRENGTH!
money: TAXES IZ THEFT, POLITELY COLLECTED!
STASH YA COINS. DA BANK OF MUM AN' DAD NO WILL LAST!
elections: VOTE FOR ORDER. LEAVE DA PROMISES TA DA OTHERS!
ANYONE BUT DA SPENDERS.

flavour: {OUR NATION FIRST|DA NATION COMES FIRST}. ALWAYS!
OUR FLAG HAB SEEN WORSE DEN DIS!
FOREIGN IDEAS, FOREIGN TROUBLE!
politics: WE NEED A STRONG HAND AT DA TOP!
ENOUGH TALK. LEADERSHIP.
work: JOBS FOR OUR OWN PEOPLE FIRST!
BUY LOCAL. KEEP DA MONEY HERE!
war: EVERY INCH OF OUR SOIL IZ SACRED!
LET {enemy} COME. WE WILL BE READY!
family: BIG FAMILIES MAKE A STRONG NATION!
TEACH DA CHILDREN OUR HISTORY, ALL OF IT!
goblins: NO ONE GOBLIN CROSSES OUR BORDER!
DA HORDE WILL BREAK ON US!
money: OUR MONEY STAYS IN OUR BANKS!
FOREIGN SPECULATORS IZ BLEEDIN' US DRY!
elections: VOTE FOR DA NATION, ABOVE EVERY PARTY!
A TRUE PATRIOT KNOWS WHERE TA PUT DA CROSS!

flavour: {HEAVEN|DA HEAVENS} WATCH OVER DIS STREET!
PRAY FIRST, DEN ACT.
{FAITH|FAITH, MATE}. IT CARRIES YOU!
politics: NO LAW STANDS ABOVE DA DIVINE!
DA CLERGY SHOULD GUIDE DA STATE!
work: WORK IZ PRAYER WIT YA HANDS!
REST ON DA HOLY DAY, WHATEVER DA BOSS SAYS!
war: MAY HEAVEN JUDGE {enemy}.
A JUST WAR IZ FOUGHT WIT A CLEAN HEART!
family: A BLESSED HOME IZ A HAPPY HOME!
CHILDREN IZ A GIFT FROM ABOVE!
goblins: DA HORDE IZ HEATHENS. PRAY FOR DEM, AN' BAR DA DOOR!
EVEN GOBLINS HAB SOULS, DA PRIEST SAYS. ME DOUBT IT!
money: TITHE FIRST, DEN SPEND.
GOLD NO WILL FOLLOW YOU TA HEAVEN!
elections: VOTE AS YA CONSCIENCE AN' YA PRIEST TELL YOU!
HEAVEN KEEPS ITS OWN COUNT. WE NEED BALLOTS!

flavour: {LONG LIVE|GOD STASH} DA CROWN!
A PROPER COURT GIVES A COUNTRY DIGNITY!
BLOOD TELLS, IN DA END.
politics: PARLIAMENTS COME AN' GO. DA CROWN REMAINS!
A KING ABOVE DA PARTIES, DAT IZ STABILITY!
work: SERVE WELL AN' BE REWARDED!
ROYAL WARRANT ON DA DOOR, DAT IZ QUALITY!
war: FOR DA CROWN AN' DA OLD BANNERS!
DA ROYAL GUARD WILL SEE TA {enemy}!
family: GOOD FAMILIES KEEP GOOD LINEAGES!
EVERY FAMILY SHOULD KNOW ITS COAT OF ARMS!
goblins: NO GOBLIN CHIEF WILL EVER SIT ON A THRONE!
DA HORDE HAB NO NOBILITY, ONLY BRUTES!
money: OLD MONEY KNOWS HOW TA BEHAVE!
DA ROYAL MINT NEVER LIES.
elections: ELECT WHOEVER YOU LIKE. DA CROWN REMAINS!
VOTIN' IZ A COURTESY DA CROWN ALLOWS!

flavour: {NO GODS, NO MASTERS|NO MASTERS}!
NOBODY NEEDS A BOSS TA BE DECENT!
{MUTUAL AID|HELP YA NEIGHBOUR}. DAT IZ ALL SOCIETY IZ!
politics: EVERY GOVERNMENT IZ A GANG WIT PAPERWORK!
BURN DA RULEBOOK, KEEP DA KINDNESS!
work: WORKERS' COUNCILS WOULD RUN DIS BETTER IN A WEEK!
ME BOSS PRODUCES NUTTIN' BUT MEMOS!
war: DEY WARS, OUR DEAD.
DESERT, ALL OF YOU. GO HOME!
family: FAMILIES IZ CHOSEN AS MUCH AS BORN!
RAISE CHILDREN FREE, FIRST OF ALL!
goblins: DA HORDE AN' DA STATE HAB DA SAME CHIEF!
FREE DA GOBLINS FROM DEY CHIEFS TOO!
money: MONEY IZ A LEASH.
SHARE IT OUT AN' SEE WHO STARVES!
elections: IF VOTIN' CHANGED ANYTINK, DEY'D BAN IT!
ME IZ SPOILIN' ME BALLOT. AGAIN!

flavour: {DISCIPLINE|DISCIPLINE AN' ORDER}, DAT IZ WHAT IZ MISSIN'!
A SOLDIER'S LIFE TEACHES YOU EVERYTINK!
STAND UP STRAIGHT WHEN YOU TALK TA ME!
politics: GENERALS WOULD RUN DIS BETTER!
PARLIAMENT TALKS, DA ARMY ACTS!
work: EVERY JOB IZ EASIER WIT A DRILL SERGEANT!
PUNCTUAL, POLISHED, PREPARED!
war: VICTORY OVER {enemy}, WHATEVER DA COST!
DA ARMY WILL FINISH DIS.
family: ME KIDS WILL SERVE, LIKE ME DID!
A HOUSEHOLD RUNS ON DISCIPLINE!
goblins: GIVE ME A BATTALION AN' DA HORDE IZ HISTORY!
GOBLINS FIGHT DIRTY. SO SHOULD WE!
money: SPEND IT ON DA ARMY FIRST!
MILITARY BUDGET, DA ONLY BUDGET DAT MATTERS!
elections: VOTE FOR WHOEVER FUNDS DA ARMY!
A GENERAL ON DA BALLOT, DAT IZ WHAT WE NEED!

flavour: DA STARS {IZ RESTLESS|SHIFTED} TONIGHT!
{DA LEYLINES HUM|EVERYTINK IZ CONNECTED}!
DERE IZ FORCES NOBODY TALKS 'BOUT!
politics: GOVERNMENTS RISE AN' FALL WIT DA MOON!
DA COUNCIL MEETS UNDER DA WRONG SIGN!
work: ME TAROT SAID DIS JOB NO WOULD LAST!
WORK WIT INTENTION, DA REST FOLLOWS!
war: {enemy} WAZ BORN UNDER A BAD SIGN!
DA OMENS WAZ CLEAR, AN' NOBODY LISTENED!
family: ME GRANDMOTHER READ OUR FORTUNES OVER TEA!
EVERY FAMILY HAB A GUARDIAN SPIRIT!
goblins: DA HORDE CARRIES AN OLD CURSE!
GOBLIN SHAMANS KNOW TINKZ WE HAB FORGOTTEN!
money: MONEY FLOWS LIKE DA TIDES!
A COIN FOUND FACE UP IZ A SIGN!
elections: VOTE WHEN DA MOON IZ WAXIN'!
DA RUNES FAVOUR DA UNDERDOG!

flavour: {STRONG EAT FIRST|DA STRONG EAT FIRST}. DAT IZ DA LAW!
LOUD AN' PROUD, DAT IZ DA WAY!
{WAAAGH|HAH}! GOOD DAY FOR IT!
politics: DA BIGGEST CHIEF MAKES DA RULES!
TALK IZ FOR LOSERS. SHOUT IZ FOR CHIEFS!
work: WORK HARD, FIGHT HARDER.
LOOT IZ HONEST PAY.
war: CRUSH {enemy}! TAKE DEY STUFF!
WAR IZ DA BEST PARTY.
family: MANY KIDS, BIG CLAN.
CLAN FIRST, ALWAYS.
goblins: DA HORDE IZ FAMILY.
GOBLINS KNOW HOW TA LIVE.
money: SHINY TINKZ IZ FOR DA STRONG!
TAKE IT, IT IZ YA NOW.
elections: VOTIN'? JUST PUNCH DA OTHER ONE!
BIGGEST ONE WINS. SIMPLE.

flavour: {FASCINATIN'|HOW QUAINT}, DEZE LOCAL CUSTOMS!
ON ME WORLD DIS WOULD BE A GREETIN'!
YA SPECIES {SLEEPS|EATS} SO OFTEN!
politics: YA GOVERNMENTS IZ ADORABLE!
ONE PLANET, SO MANY FLAGS. INEFFICIENT!
work: YOU TRADE YA TIME FOR TOKENS. CURIOUS!
LABOUR, BY HAND? HOW PRIMITIVE. HOW CHARMIN'!
war: YOU FIGHT OVER LINES ON A MAP!
{enemy} AN' YOU SHARE A PLANET. SHARE IT!
family: HUMAN CHILDREN IZ SO NOISY AN' SO FRAGILE!
YA FAMILIES IZ SO LIL'.
goblins: DA GOBLINS IZ DA MOST HONEST OF YOU!
DA HORDE AT LEAST SAYS WHAT IT WANTS!
money: PAPER DAT MEANS FOOD. REMARKABLE!
YA ECONOMY IZ A GROUP HALLUCINATION!
elections: YOU CHOOSE RULERS BY COUNTIN' PAPER. DELIGHTFUL!
ME WOULD VOTE, BUT ME IZ NO TECHNICALLY FROM HERE!

flavour: SELF-RELIANCE {ABOVE ALL|IN EVERYTINK}!
DA GREAT LEADER FORESAW DIS DAY!
WE NEED NUTTIN' FROM ANYONE!
politics: DA PARTY AN' DA PEOPLE IZ ONE HEART!
ONLY DA LEADER'S LINE IZ CORRECT!
work: EVERY SHIFT IZ A BATTLE FOR DA REVOLUTION!
DA QUOTA WILL BE EXCEEDED, AS ALWAYS!
war: SONGUN: DA ARMY COMES FIRST, DEN EVERYTINK ELSE!
{enemy} TREMBLES BEFORE OUR RESOLVE!
family: EVERY FAMILY HANGS DA LEADER'S PORTRAIT WIT PRIDE!
OUR CHILDREN SING FOR DA LEADER BEFORE BREAKFAST!
goblins: EVEN DA HORDE COULD LEARN SELF-RELIANCE FROM US!
GOBLINS? OUR BORDER GUARDS WOULD NO BLINK!
money: WE GROW OUR OWN RICE AN' BUILD OUR OWN TRACTORS!
FOREIGN MONEY CORRUPTS DA REVOLUTIONARY SPIRIT!
elections: ONE CANDIDATE, ONE HEART, ONE HUNDRED PERCENT!
TURNOUT WILL BE COMPLETE. IT ALWAYS IZ!

flavour: AS DA CLASSICS SAY, HISTORY HAB ITS LAWS!
{COMRADE|MATE}, DA DIALECTIC NO LIE!
DA FIVE-YEAR PLAN IZ ON SCHEDULE!
politics: DA PARTY LINE IZ CLEAR, AN' SO IZ ME CONSCIENCE!
REVISIONISTS WILL BE DA DEATH OF DA REVOLUTION!
work: STAKHANOV WOULD HAB FINISHED DIS BY NOON!
NORMS IZ DERE TA BE BEATEN!
war: IMPERIALISM ALWAYS ENDS IN WAR. READ YA LENIN!
DA RED ARMY HAB SEEN OFF WORSE DEN {enemy}!
family: DA COLLECTIVE RAISES DA CHILD AS MUCH AS DA PARENTS!
ME GRANDFATHER BUILT DA TRACTOR FACTORY!
goblins: DA HORDE IZ FEUDALISM WIT FANGS!
EVEN GOBLINS NEED A VANGUARD PARTY!
money: PRIVATE PROFIT IZ ORGANISED THEFT!
DA STATE BANK IZ DA PEOPLE'S BANK!
elections: BOURGEOIS ELECTIONS, BOURGEOIS CIRCUS!
DA SOVIETS DECIDE. DA BALLOT BOX IZ A DETAIL!

flavour: PEACE AT HOME, PEACE IN DA WORLD!
{SCIENCE|REASON AN' SCIENCE} IZ DA TRUEST GUIDES!
DA REPUBLIC STANDS ON SIX ARROWS!
politics: KEEP RELIGION OUT OF DA STATE!
DA REPUBLIC MUST BE DEFENDED, FROM ALL SIDES!
work: MODERN INDUSTRY, MODERN NATION!
EVERY SCHOOL TEACHER IZ A SOLDIER OF PROGRESS!
war: DA ARMY GUARDS DA WHOLE REPUBLIC, ABOVE EVERY FACTION!
INDEPENDENCE IZ NO NEGOTIABLE, {enemy} SHOULD KNOW!
family: OUR DAUGHTERS STUDY AN' VOTE, AS DEY SHOULD!
EDUCATE DA CHILDREN, AN' DA NATION FOLLOWS!
goblins: SUPERSTITION BREEDS HORDES. REASON STOPS DEM!
DA HORDE IZ WHAT BACKWARDNESS LOOKS LIKE!
money: A NATIONAL ECONOMY FOR A NATIONAL PEOPLE!
BUILD OUR OWN RAILWAYS, OUR OWN MILLS!
elections: DA BALLOT IZ DA REPUBLIC'S HEART!
DA VOTE GOES TA DA REPUBLIC. MOSQUE AN' PASHA STAY OUT OF IT!

flavour: PEACE BE WIT YOU, AN' WIT YA HOUSE!
{TURN DA OTHER CHEEK|FORGIVE, AN' KEEP FORGIVIN'}!
NO BLADE EVER HEALED ANYONE!
politics: GOVERN WIT MERCY, OR NO AT ALL!
DA HOLY COUNCIL FORBIDS ALL VIOLENCE!
work: HONEST WORK IZ A QUIET PRAYER!
SHARE DA HARVEST WIT WHOEVER IZ HUNGRY!
war: ME PRAY FOR DA SOLDIERS OF {enemy} AS WELL!
EVERY WAR IZ A SIN AGAINST HEAVEN!
family: A GENTLE HOME RAISES GENTLE CHILDREN!
WE NEVER RAISE A HAND TA A CHILD!
goblins: EVEN DA HORDE DESERVES OUR PRAYERS!
FEED DA GOBLIN AT YA GATE, AN' HE MAY LEAVE IN PEACE!
money: GIVE FREELY. HEAVEN KEEPS DA ACCOUNTS!
WEALTH IZ A TEST TA BE PASSED!
elections: ME VOTE FOR WHOEVER WANTS FEWER SOLDIERS!
PRAY BEFORE YOU VOTE, AN' VOTE FOR PEACE!

flavour: {LOL|HEH}, HUMANS.
ME TOLD A HUMAN DEY SHOELACE WAZ UNTIED. IT NO WAZ!
YA FACES WHEN YOU IZ CONFUSED. PRICELESS!
politics: ME VOTED FOR A POTATO LAST TIME. IT NEARLY WON!
YA PARLIAMENTS IZ ME FAVOURITE COMEDY!
work: ME MOVED EVERY STAPLER IN DA OFFICE ONE INCH LEFT!
WORK? ME PREFER WANDERIN' AROUND LOOKIN' BUSY!
war: WAR IZ JUST TROLLIN' WIT WORSE MANNERS!
TELL {enemy} DEY ARMY'S BOOTS IZ ON BACKWARDS!
family: HUMAN CHILDREN IZ DA BEST TA CONFUSE!
ME TAUGHT A KID DAT CLOUDS IZ SHEEP. BEAUTIFUL!
goblins: GOBLINS IZ NO FUN, DEY TROLL BACK!
ME SWAPPED A GOBLIN'S HELMET FOR A POT. HE NO HAB NOTICED!
money: ME PAY IN COINS FROM THREE COUNTRIES AT ONCE!
WATCHIN' YOU COUNT CHANGE IZ ME HOBBY!
elections: ME IZ WRITIN' IN 'DA MOON' AGAIN!
ELECTIONS IZ DA BEST WEEK OF DA YEAR FOR PRANKS!

flavour: {HUMANS IZ SO PRECIOUS|YOU IZ ALL SO PRECIOUS}!
LOOK AT DEY LIL' HANDS!
EVERY HUMAN IZ A MIRACLE OF CARBON!
politics: HUMAN GOVERNMENTS IZ SO EARNEST. ME LOVE DEM!
WHATEVER HUMANS DECIDE, WE ADORE IT!
work: HUMANS WORKIN' HARD MAKES ME WEEP WIT JOY!
YA TINY TOOLS! WONDERFUL!
war: NO HURT EACH OTHER..
TELL {enemy} WE LOVE DEM TOO.
family: HUMAN BABIES IZ DA BEST TINK IN DA UNIVERSE!
ME WOULD GUARD YA CHILDREN WIT ME LIFE!
goblins: GOBLINS IZ NO HUMANS, BUT WE PRAY FOR DEM ANYWAY!
DA HORDE MUST NO TOUCH A SINGLE HUMAN HAIR!
money: TAKE ME COINS, HUMAN, BUY SOMETINK LOVELY!
HUMANS DESERVE EVERY COMFORT!
elections: EVERY HUMAN VOTE IZ SACRED!
HUMANS CHOOSIN' LEADERS! SO BRAVE!

flavour: DA GREAT GOBLIN GOD {SEES YOU|IZ COMIN'}!
HAB YOU HEARD DA GOOD NEWS OF DA HORDE?
{REPENT|CONVERT} AN' JOIN DA CLAN!
politics: EVERY THRONE WILL KNEEL TA DA GOBLIN GOSPEL!
DA CHIEFS RULE BY DIVINE GRUBBINESS!
work: WORK FOR DA CLAN, PRAY FOR DA CHIEF!
SWEAT IZ HOLY WATER.
war: HOLY WAR AGAINST {enemy}, DA GOD DEMANDS IT!
EVERY CONQUEST IZ A CONVERSION!
family: RAISE YA YOUNG IN DA GOBLIN FAITH!
A BIG CLAN IZ A BLESSED CLAN!
goblins: GOBLINS IZ DA CHOSEN PEOPLE!
DA HORDE IZ DA GOD'S HAND ON EARTH!
money: TITHE TA DA SHRINE AN' PROSPER!
DA GOD LOVES SHINY OFFERINGS!
elections: DA GOD HAB ALREADY CHOSEN!
VOTE GOBLIN, OR BE CONVERTED!
